buyer.0.title: Welcome to Verdaxis!
buyer.0.content: The compliance-first marketplace for verified sustainable marine fuels. Let's take a quick tour of your Buyer Console.
buyer.1.title: Intelligence Map
buyer.1.content: See real-time port availability and fuel sources across global shipping lanes. Click a port pin to browse available fuels and suppliers.
buyer.2.title: Marketplace
buyer.2.content: Browse and purchase verified sustainable marine fuels. Filter by fuel type, port, and price. Place bids or buy at listed prices.
buyer.3.title: Forward Curve
buyer.3.content: Live price feeds and trade data across all fuel types and global ports. Track market movements and spot pricing opportunities.
buyer.4.title: Forward Curve
buyer.4.content: Visualise the market's view of future prices across time windows — Spot through quarterly. Bars show best bid/ask, the line tracks mid price. Auto-refreshes every 30 seconds.
buyer.5.title: Market Activity Feed
buyer.5.content: Real-time stream of market events — new listings, price crossings, and matched trades. Events relevant to your organisation are highlighted with a coloured border.
buyer.6.title: Price Alerts
buyer.6.content: Set threshold alerts on any product — get notified when prices cross above or below your target. Free tier includes 5 active alerts; upgrade for unlimited.
buyer.7.title: My Fleet
buyer.7.content: Manage your vessels, track compliance scores per ship, and plan upcoming refuelling schedules across all ports.
buyer.8.title: Compliance
buyer.8.content: Monitor your FuelEU Maritime, EU ETS, and CII obligations. Run what-if scenarios to optimise your fuel mix before purchasing.
buyer.9.title: My Trades
buyer.9.content: Track all your orders and completed trades. View delivery status, confirmation timelines, and full trade history.
buyer.10.title: Notifications
buyer.10.content: Stay updated on trade confirmations, price alerts, and compliance deadlines. You're all set — start exploring!

supplier.1.content: Your operational hub. See outstanding orders, recent trades, inventory levels, and revenue performance at a glance.

supplier.2.content: Manage incoming purchase requests. Accept, decline, or counter-quote buyer orders from verified vessel operators worldwide.

supplier.3.content: Live intelligence on buyer demand across ports and fuel types. Spot high-demand opportunities before competitors do.
supplier.4.title: Forward Curve

supplier.5.title: Forward Curve

supplier.6.title: Market Activity Feed
supplier.6.content: Real-time stream of market events — new listings, price crossings, and matched trades. Events relevant to your organisation are highlighted with a coloured border.
supplier.7.title: Price Alerts
supplier.7.content: Set threshold alerts on any product — get notified when prices cross above or below your target. Free tier includes 5 active alerts; upgrade for unlimited.
supplier.8.title: Inventory
supplier.8.content: Manage your fuel stock across ports. Create listings, set prices, and track available quantities in real time.
supplier.9.title: Analytics
supplier.9.content: Sales performance, revenue trends, and buyer behaviour insights. Understand your market position and optimise pricing strategy.
supplier.10.title: My Trades
supplier.10.content: Track all completed and in-progress trades. View delivery confirmations, payment status, and full trade history.
supplier.11.title: Notifications
supplier.11.content: Real-time alerts for new orders, price changes, and platform updates. You're all set — start selling!
